explanation.summaryZh: 只读一遍但答题的组一周后记得更多，说明读完后的自我测试有助于记忆。

evidence.quote: the other group read it once and then spent the rest of the time answering questions about it. A week later, the second group remembered much more.

options.text: Reading more times always leads to better memory.
Answering questions after reading improves memory.
The students in the second group were cleverer.
